title: Adaptive Personalization Under Preference Epistemic Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.40930v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human preferences change over time: an established preference may remain valid over time, become uncertain as context shifts, or be explicitly revised. Effective personalization requires conversational AI to adapt its response strategy to evolving preferences rather than relying on passive memory retrieval. We formalize this capability as adaptive personalization under epistemic uncertainty. A human preference study further confirms that people favor state-contingent response strategies as preference uncertainty changes. To evaluate whether language models mirror this adaptation, we create a multilingual benchmark spanning 250 personas, 5 languages, and 25K conversational turns that decouples strategy selection from response execution. Across eight closed- and open-weight models, we uncover a recognition-generation gap: models reliably identify appropriate strategies when selecting among candidate options, but collapse during open-ended

translated_title: 偏好认知不确定性下的自适应个性化
translated_abstract: 人类偏好会随时间变化：一个既定的偏好可能长期保持有效，可能随着情境变化而变得不确定，也可能被明确地修订。有效的个性化要求对话式AI能够根据不断演变的偏好调整其回应策略，而不是依赖被动的记忆检索。我们将这种能力形式化为“偏好认知不确定性下的自适应个性化”。一项人类偏好研究进一步证实，随着偏好不确定性的变化，人们更倾向于采取依赖状态的自适应回应策略。为了评估语言模型是否也具备这种适应能力，我们构建了一个多语言基准，涵盖250个人设、5种语言和25K轮对话，该基准将策略选择与回应执行解耦。在八个闭源与开源权重模型上，我们发现了一种“识别-生成鸿沟”：模型在候选选项中进行选择时能够可靠地识别出合适的策略，但在开放式生成时表现崩溃。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出并形式化了“偏好认知不确定性下的自适应个性化”任务，构建了一个涵盖250个人设、5种语言、25K轮对话的多语言基准，揭示了现有大模型普遍存在的“识别-生成鸿沟”——即模型能从候选选项中正确识别偏好适应策略，却在开放式生成中失效。
